name: aat-m1-contracts
description: Language-neutral API contracts and validation tooling for IF4031 M1

scripts.check: npm run lint:openapi && npm run lint:proto && npm run check:proto-format && npm run build:proto
scripts.bundle: redocly bundle bmkg -o dist/openapi/bmkg.yaml && redocly bundle pvmbg -o dist/openapi/pvmbg.yaml && redocly bundle gateway -o dist/openapi/gateway.yaml
